name: identity_account_defaults_update
title: Update account Signature defaults
description: App-only account FX write. Sets or clears the account-wide Signature defaults that new projects inherit. opener_library_entry_id/outro_library_entry_id point at saved account library entries, opener_slot/outro_slot from account Signature Studio save a new library entry and make it the default, and blank/none/disabled clears a role. enabled controls whether new projects start with the Signature on.

opener_library_entry_id.description: Saved opener entry id (ilib_...). Blank/none clears the opener default; omitted preserves it.

outro_library_entry_id.description: Saved outro entry id (ilib_...). Blank/none clears the outro default; omitted preserves it.

opener_slot.description: Optional opener slot payload {preset_id, params, gain_db, uses_title}; creates/reuses an account library row and sets it as the default.

outro_slot.description: Optional outro slot payload {preset_id, params, gain_db, uses_title}; creates/reuses an account library row and sets it as the default.

enabled.description: Whether new projects start with the account Signature on. Omitted preserves the current value; first slot save defaults true.
